results.title: International Monetary Fund | April 2026 Global Economy Tested Again
10 Charts To Address Concerns On 2026 Geopolitical Conflict
Stock Market Outlook 2026: Political Risks Loom
War Darkens Global Economic Outlook and Reshapes Policy Priorities

summary_raw: Middle East conflict has closed Strait of Hormuz and damaged critical energy facilities, risking major energy crisis. IMF reference forecast: global growth 3.1%, headline inflation 4.4% in 2026. U.S.-Iran tensions ongoing — today (May 4) conflicting reports of Iranian attack on U.S. warship. Tariff uncertainty, new Fed leadership, and midterm elections add to investor uncertainty.
